title: Goodfellas — Funny How? (Copacabana Booth)
subtitle: Scorsese 1970s 35mm Nightclub · Max-3 Cast: Deron, Ajay & Sheren

setups.GF2_WIDE: 1970s Copacabana crimson-velvet VIP booth bathed in glowing red fringed table lamps; Deron centered-left in woven bamboo conical rice paddy hat and ornate red dragon Chinese silk robe holding crystal scotch glass; Ajay right in crisp 1970s ivory dinner jacket & dark tie; Sheren between/beside them in chic 1970s black velvet evening dress.
setups.GF2_DERON: Crimson-lit Tommy DeVito MCU on Deron wearing woven bamboo conical rice paddy hat (generous headroom above cone tip) and ornate red dragon Chinese silk robe, holding crystal scotch glass under warm red club lamp.
setups.GF2_AJAY: Henry Hill MCU on Ajay wearing 1970s ivory/cream mob dinner jacket, white dress shirt, dark tie, slicked hair under smoky crimson Copa club lighting.
setups.GF2_SHEREN: MCU on Sheren wearing chic 1970s black velvet nightclub evening dress and gold earrings beside red fringed Copa lamp.
setups.GF2_CLIMAX_FX: Static medium-wide Copacabana VIP booth practical-FX shot: Deron sitting ramrod-still under bamboo hat and red dragon robe as a violent torrent of disgusting brown diarrhea blasts from beneath the crimson linen tablecloth across the burgundy carpet and Ajay's cream trousers.
setups.GF2_AJAY_POST: Edited from GF2_AJAY: stunned, wide-eyed Ajay with brown splatters on his ivory dinner jacket lapel in silent frozen Copa club lighting.

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Warm crimson Copacabana 3-person booth two/three-shot; Deron left in conical bamboo hat & red dragon robe holding court over crystal glass.
shots.dialogue: Wah, that rival bookie try pay short envelope last night lah! Me walk in back room, take cash, take whole crate off-truck oyster too—show whole neighborhood who boss, right or not?!
shots.tts: Wah, that rival bookie try pay short envelope last night lah! Me walk in back room, take cash, take whole crate off-truck oyster too—show whole neighborhood who boss, right or not?!

shots.speaker: fx
shots.cam: Static Copa booth three-shot hold as a loud wet stomach groan rumbles beneath the red tablecloth; Deron keeps stony composure while Ajay glances down.

shots.speaker: ajay
shots.cam: MCU on laughing Ajay in ivory 1970s dinner jacket raising scotch glass fondly.
shots.dialogue: Arre baap re, Deron! What timing, yaar! Big tough gangster stomach making sound like my nineteen-eighty-four Porsche gearbox! You are total funny guy, yaar!
shots.tts: Arre baap re, Deron! What timing, yaar! Big tough gangster stomach making sound like my nineteen-eighty-four Porsche gearbox! You are total funny guy, yaar!

shots.speaker: sheren
shots.cam: MCU on Sheren in black velvet evening dress setting her glass down very slowly.
shots.dialogue: Ajay. Stop talking. Right now.
shots.tts: [icy, quiet, urgent warning] Ajay. Stop talking. Right now.

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Frozen crimson MCU on Deron beneath bamboo hat; background chatter drops DEAD SILENT.
shots.dialogue: Funny how lah?
shots.tts: Funny how lah?

shots.speaker: ajay
shots.cam: MCU on Ajay chuckling nervously in crimson tungsten light.
shots.dialogue: Simply—you know what I am saying, yaar! Big shakedown story, then stomach goes boom—it is total amazing comedy, Deron!
shots.tts: Simply—you know what I am saying, yaar! Big shakedown story, then stomach goes boom—it is total amazing comedy, Deron!

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Dead-still MCU on Deron glaring sharply from beneath bamboo hat.
shots.dialogue: No, no, me no know. You say funny two time. How me funny ah? Me look like circus clown sit here entertain you while you drink scotch, right or not?
shots.tts: No, no, me no know. You say funny two time. How me funny ah? Me look like circus clown sit here entertain you while you drink scotch, right or not?

shots.speaker: sheren
shots.cam: MCU on deadpan Sheren lifting her evening clutch off the floor.
shots.dialogue: Yikes. You just walked straight into a code red, Ajay.
shots.tts: [flat, sharp, unapologetic realism] Yikes. You just walked straight into a code red, Ajay.

shots.speaker: ajay
shots.cam: MCU on anxious Ajay pleading with wide eyes.
shots.dialogue: Negative, Deron! No clown, yaar! Please—I am saying you are eating bad hijacked oyster and sitting so straight like mafia don—it is simply amusing!
shots.tts: Negative, Deron! No clown, yaar! Please—I am saying you are eating bad hijacked oyster and sitting so straight like mafia don—it is simply amusing!

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Slow ominous Scorsese push-in on Deron in conical bamboo hat & red dragon silk robe.
shots.dialogue: Amusing ah?! Whole room owe me money, half Brooklyn scared look at red dragon robe, and you think boss stomach is big joke lah?!
shots.tts: Amusing ah?! Whole room owe me money, half Brooklyn scared look at red dragon robe, and you think boss stomach is big joke lah?!

shots.speaker: ajay
shots.cam: MCU on sweating Ajay in clinical doctor panic.
shots.dialogue: Arre baap re, Deron, look at your face—it is completely grey! Your bowel sounds are total hyperactive—please do the needful and go restroom fast fast!
shots.tts: Arre baap re, Deron, look at your face—it is completely grey! Your bowel sounds are total hyperactive—please do the needful and go restroom fast fast!

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Locked stony glare under bamboo brim.
shots.dialogue: Boss no run to toilet in front of whole Copacabana, lah! Nobody leave table until me say finish! Now tell me again—how me funny?!
shots.tts: Boss no run to toilet in front of whole Copacabana, lah! Nobody leave table until me say finish! Now tell me again—how me funny?!

shots.speaker: sheren
shots.cam: Calm MCU on Sheren leaning cleanly away from center booth.
shots.dialogue: Relax, Ajay. Don't look at his eyes, and definitely don't sit directly in front of him.
shots.tts: [cool, dry, calm warning] Relax, Ajay. Don't look at his eyes, and definitely don't sit directly in front of him.

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Razor-locked CU on Deron under crimson lamp glow.
shots.dialogue: You smart doctor, yaar? Big brain surgeon? Explain to whole table right now what so funny about me!
shots.tts: You smart doctor, yaar? Big brain surgeon? Explain to whole table right now what so funny about me!

shots.speaker: ajay
shots.cam: Frozen stiff MCU on terrified Ajay.
shots.dialogue: Nothing is funny, Deron! Zero percent funny! This is a totally serious gangster stomach emergency and I made massive mistake!
shots.tts: Nothing is funny, Deron! Zero percent funny! This is a totally serious gangster stomach emergency and I made massive mistake!

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Silent three-second freeze broken only by icy whisper.
shots.dialogue: ...Massive mistake.
shots.tts: Massive mistake.

shots.speaker: ajay
shots.cam: MCU on frozen Ajay whispering carefully.
shots.dialogue: Yes, boss. Very massive mistake. Please, Deron—just stand up slow slow.
shots.tts: Yes, boss. Very massive mistake. Please, Deron—just stand up slow slow.

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Ice-still CU on Deron unblinking.
shots.dialogue: Me no stand up.
shots.tts: Me no stand up.

shots.speaker: fx
shots.cam: Static medium-wide Copacabana VIP booth shot: Deron keeps stony eye contact beneath his bamboo hat as a pressurized torrent of disgusting brown diarrhea explodes out from beneath the crimson tablecloth across the carpet, table lamp base, and Ajay's ivory slacks.

shots.speaker: ajay
shots.cam: MCU on stunned, brown-splattered Ajay gaping in disbelief.
shots.dialogue: Arre baap re... my white tuxedo trousers, yaar! You really did not leave the table!
shots.tts: Ah-ray bahp ray, my white tuck-seedo trousers, yaar! You really did not leave the table!

shots.speaker: sheren
shots.cam: Deadpan MCU on completely unfazed Sheren in black velvet dress.
shots.dialogue: Obviously. He never bluffs.
shots.tts: [dry, calm, completely unbothered] Obviously. He never bluffs.

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Calm MCU on Deron sipping scotch serenely under bamboo hat & red dragon robe.
shots.dialogue: See? Very serious business lah. Nobody laugh now, right or not?
shots.tts: See? Very serious business lah. Nobody laugh now, right or not?

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Commanding MCU on Deron setting his scotch glass softly on the table.
shots.dialogue: Now you pay dinner bill, pay carpet guy, and nobody say one word outside Copacabana, understand ah?
shots.tts: Now you pay dinner bill, pay carpet guy, and nobody say one word outside Copacabana, understand ah?

shots.speaker: sheren
shots.cam: Closing deadpan smirk on Sheren raising her glass toward waiter.
shots.dialogue: Bring two more scotches and a mop. And put the dry cleaning on his tab.
shots.tts: [cool, wicked, deadpan closing verdict] Bring two more scotches and a mop. And put the dry cleaning on his tab.
